name: Ahri
title: The Nine-Tailed Fox

passive.name: Essence Theft

description.normalized: Grants a stack of Essence Theft if her ability hits a target. At 3 stacks, Ahri's next ability that hits an enemy heals her for 40 (+20% AP). If an enemy champion that Ahri has damaged within 3 seconds dies, she will consume their essence to heal herself for 80 (+35% AP).

passive.rawParsedText:
Grants a stack of Essence Theft if her ability hits a target. At 3 stacks, Ahri's next ability that hits an enemy heals her for 40 (+20% AP).

If an enemy champion that Ahri has damaged within 3 seconds dies, she will consume their essence to heal herself for 80 (+35% AP).

q.name: Orb of Deception

description.normalized: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing 40 / 75 / 110 / 145 (+45% AP) magic damage on the way out and 40 / 75 / 110 / 145 (+45% AP) true damage on the way back.

q.rawParsedText: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing 40 / 75 / 110 / 145 (+45% AP) magic damage on the way out and 40 / 75 / 110 / 145 (+45% AP) true damage on the way back.

w.name: Fox-Fire

description.normalized: Ahri gains 45% movement speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies for 45 / 80 / 115 / 150 (+35% AP) magic damage.

w.rawParsedText: Ahri gains 45% movement speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies for 45 / 80 / 115 / 150 (+35% AP) magic damage.

e.name: Charm

description.normalized: Ahri blows a kiss that does 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.

e.rawParsedText: Ahri blows a kiss that does 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.

r.name: Spirit Rush

description.normalized: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies for 60 / 90 / 120 (+35% AP) magic damage. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown. During Spirit Rush, if Ahri devours a champion's essence with Essence Theft, Ahri will extend Spirit Rush's recast duration up to 10 seconds, and she gains an extra charge of Spirit Rush (Can store up to 3 charges). Dash range increases while leveling up. Essence bolts attack champions first.
